content.comment_body: Hello, I'm working on a [product_name] with three analog inputs (4..20mA) via two [product_name] modules and one analog output. The setup should route the analog input to the output depending on three digital inputs: if I1 is high, then the analog output equals Analog Input 1; if I4 is high, it equals Analog Input 2; and if I3 is high, it equals Analog Input 3. What is the recommended way to achieve this? Appreciate any support you can provide.
That's exactly what I needed, thanks!
